title: Ned Helps a Bug
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters dr, fl, fr.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling standing at the edge of a muddy patch, spotting a small bug stuck in the mud.
The small bug struggling but unable to lift itself out of the thick mud.
Close view of the thick dark mud holding the small bug in place.
Ned the duckling leaning down to help the bug.
Ned the duckling digging into the mud around the bug with his bill.
Ned the duckling lifting the small bug free of the mud.
The small bug sitting safely on a brown log beside the muddy patch.
The small bug curled up asleep on the brown log.
Ned the duckling standing proudly beside the log where the rescued bug naps.
